_comment: Per-skill dependency manifest read by the vendored preflight engine. Base checks — git work tree, gh installed+authenticated, jq — are always run. This file lists what review-pr additionally needs and what is optional.
notes: Verification (Tier 1) is best-effort: a finding is promoted to 'confirmed' only when a cheap, throwaway, read-only-to-shared-state check succeeds. Missing language runtimes / test runners / a local Postgres simply leave findings as 'hypothesis' — never an error.
Reviewing a foreign repo needs `gh repo clone` access to that repo; without it, ensure-checkout.sh fails loudly and review-pr falls back to diff-only diagnosis (no verify tier).
